review_notes: I read the whole target file. I also read the related definitions and lemmas in AxisDeriv, MultiPartialOrderShift, LaplacianMultiPartialBridge, MultiPartialGradPairBridge and AnnulusBoundsEnstrophy. The target declares no simp lemmas and no simp attributes. The only simp-interface issue I found is that the identification `multiPartial g (Pi.single i 1) = spatialPartial g i` is not available as a canonical simp rewrite. It is proved three times, in different forms, and none of the copies is tagged @[simp]. This target file re-proves it inline twice. I did not check for an import cycle in adding `MultiPartialGradPairBridge` or `LaplacianMultiPartialBridge` as imports of the target. `MultiPartialGradPairBridge` imports only Statements and Analysis modules, so a cycle seems unlikely. I did not check whether making the lemma @[simp] would disturb other uses of `multiPartial` in simp sets elsewhere. I cannot run Lean, so none of the proposed changes has been compiled.

findings.problem: The proof needs `multiPartial g (Pi.single j 1) (y, t) = spatialPartial g j (y, t)`, but no simp lemma for it is available here. So `h_rewrite1` and `h_rewrite2` each re-derive it by hand. Each copy goes through `slice_spatialPartial_iterate`, `Function.iterate_one`, `multiPartial_slice`, `fin_cases i` and `simpa [G]`. The same identity exists as `spatialPartial_eq_multiPartial_single` (`spatialPartial` → `multiPartial` direction, in LaplacianMultiPartialBridge). It also exists as `multiPartial_single_eq_spatialPartial` (`multiPartial` → `spatialPartial`, in MultiPartialGradPairBridge). A third private copy in AnnulusBoundsEnstrophy uses the `fun k => if k = j then 1 else 0` form of the multi-index. None of these is tagged @[simp], and they point in opposite directions. Users therefore cannot normalise `multiPartial _ (Pi.single j 1) _` with `simp`. The `Pi.single` and `ite` multi-index forms also have no common normal form.
findings.proposed_change: Pick one canonical direction and make it the only simp rule. The first-order `multiPartial` with `Pi.single j 1` is the shape that appears in this file's statement. A natural choice is to tag the pointwise `multiPartial_single_eq_spatialPartial` (`multiPartial g (Pi.single i 1) = CKN.spatialPartial g i`) with @[simp]. Alternatively, state it in the `multiPartial g (Pi.single i 1) z = spatialPartial g i z` form and tag that. Import that file (or the LaplacianMultiPartialBridge file) here. Then replace the bodies of `h_rewrite1` and `h_rewrite2` with `simp` or `rw [multiPartial_single_eq_spatialPartial]`. Drop the private duplicate in AnnulusBoundsEnstrophy, or reprove it from the canonical lemma. Add a companion lemma for the `if k = j then 1 else 0` form, or normalise that form to `Pi.single` as well.
findings.benefit: About 30 lines of duplicated proof in this file shrink to one-line rewrites. The identification is stated once, in a single direction. Downstream consumers such as the enstrophy bound, which currently needs a private copy plus manual `rw ... at hsub`, can use `simp` directly. Any later statement mixing `multiPartial` with `Pi.single` and `spatialPartial` has one normal form.

spatialPartial g i (x, t) = multiPartial g (Pi.single i 1) (x, t)
